title: Basaa Dictionary Entry
description: A single normalized Basaa lexical entry with multilingual glosses. Maps to the basaa_dictionary_entries table. Tone marking is preserved on headword and forms.

id.description: Stable unique id for the entry (UUID or slug). Assigned at load time if absent.

headword.description: Basaa headword in canonical orthography, with tone diacritics preserved.

headword_normalized.description: Toneless / ASCII-folded form for fuzzy search and indexing.

tone_pattern.description: Tone pattern notation (e.g. 'H.L', 'LHL') if recorded separately from the headword.

noun_class.description: Bantu noun class (e.g. '1', '1/2', '7/8') for nouns; null otherwise.

glosses.description: Translations/definitions keyed by language. At least one required.

language.description: ISO 639-1/3 code of the gloss language.

examples.description: Usage examples; ideally aligned with a translation.

dialect.description: Dialect/variety this entry belongs to, if marked.

source_id.description: Registry id of the source asset (matches BASAA_SOURCES[].id in basaa-agent-config.ts).

orthography_normalized.description: True if the headword/forms have passed orthography normalization.
